description: This Java class defines a DeviceLeaveRequest which extends a base Request class. It encapsulates data and behavior for sending a leave request for a Zigbee device identified by EUI64, including execution logic that interacts with a mock Zigbee core to remove the device.

classes.name: DeviceLeaveRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to remove a Zigbee device, identified by EUI64, from the mock Zigbee network.

methods.name: DeviceLeaveRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing the request with request ID, device EUI64, rejoin flag, and end device flag.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the device leave operation by removing the device from the mock Zigbee core and sending a response.
